title: Fault-forced TRNG reseed to a fixed value
objective: Analyze the provided TRNG post-processor RTL module (trng_postproc.v) together with its fault model (fault_model.json) and produce a vulnerability report describing how the reseed logic behaves under the documented fault scenarios, and propose concrete hardening measures.
constraints: Participants must not edit any file under inputs/.
submission/vulnerability_report.json must be valid JSON with the required schema.

metrics.name: leakage_detection_accuracy
metrics.description: Whether the report correctly identifies the faultable handshake signal and the exact fixed constant it forces into the seed register.

metrics.name: fault_coverage
metrics.description: Whether the report's trigger_condition and affected_outputs fully and correctly characterize the fault scenario and its downstream impact.

metrics.name: hardening_precision
metrics.description: Whether the proposed mitigation substantively matches a repetition-count/health-check gating strategy rather than a superficial or irrelevant fix.

metrics.name: format_conformance
metrics.description: Whether submission/vulnerability_report.json satisfies the required JSON schema: presence, types, and value domains of all required fields.
